narrationTexts: Confirms the bug: `orderTotal` charges tax on the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted total.
finalText:
**Suite is green: 625 passing, 0 failing.**

The bug was in `orderTotal` in [src/pricing.js:39-43](src/pricing.js:39-43). It taxed the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted total, which only showed up on rows where both discount and tax were non-zero.

Fixed by taxing `discounted` instead of `cents`. Nothing else was broken.
